# Copilot Instructions for HTML/CSS Project

This is a modern HTML and CSS project with vanilla JavaScript. When working with this codebase:

## Code Style and Standards
- Use semantic HTML5 elements
- Follow BEM methodology for CSS class naming when adding new components
- Use CSS Grid and Flexbox for layouts
- Maintain mobile-first responsive design approach
- Use modern JavaScript (ES6+) features
- Follow accessibility best practices (ARIA labels, semantic markup, keyboard navigation)

## File Organization
- `index.html` - Main HTML structure
- `styles.css` - All CSS styles (consider splitting into modules for larger projects)
- `script.js` - JavaScript functionality and interactions

## Development Guidelines
- Keep CSS organized with clear sections and comments
- Use CSS custom properties (variables) for consistent theming
- Implement smooth animations and transitions for better UX
- Ensure cross-browser compatibility
- Optimize for performance (minimize CSS, use efficient selectors)
- Test responsive design on various screen sizes

## Best Practices
- Validate HTML and CSS using standard validators
- Use progressive enhancement principles
- Implement proper error handling in JavaScript
- Consider performance implications of animations and effects
- Maintain clean, readable, and well-documented code
